title: Use your hands for praise, not stain
summary: Let truth grow visible in the way the body moves through the day. Let this stay near the next choice: hold onto this: let speech, sight, hands, and feet become honorable through praise.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next reflexive reach, ask what your hands are serving.
